en.name: Outline-to-Solid Reveal
en.title: Outline-to-Solid Reveal: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A light point draws a product outline in 3s, then a solid body and highlight fill it in. Make this outline reveal with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: On a pure black background, fade in a light point at top center at 0.45s. Two heads extend symmetrically and draw the outline (a tube about 1.5px wide) from 1.0 to 4.0s on power2.inOut, cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), with bloom and a halo on the heads. Use an 18° fov perspective camera, fixed until 6.3s.

The solid body fades in inside the outline from 3.3 to 4.8s, overlapping the last 0.7s of the draw. The widest highlight, a separate light pass, runs 3.8–5.3s after the body. The outline then fades to 14% over 4.6–5.7s, and a 5% push-in runs 6.3–8.2s. A 2.8s logo version uses a 0.4s wireframe and a 0.6s fill wipe.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the outline, body and highlight as separate layers. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: The shape first appears as a line drawing, such as a wireframe or a path drawn by light, and then fills with a solid surface or material. The viewer reads the silhouette before the material.
Should the outline stay visible after the fill?
In this film the outline fades to 14% between 4.6 and 5.7s, after the body is in. The faint line stays as a silhouette cue while the solid takes over.

zh.name: 描边到实体显形动画
zh.title: 描边到实体显形动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 一个光点用 3s 勾出产品轮廓，随后实体和高光填满。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个描边显形动画。
howto: 纯黑背景，0.45s 在顶部中心淡入一个光点。两个线头对称向两侧延伸，在 1.0–4.0s 用 power2.inOut（cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)）画完整圈轮廓，线宽约 1.5px，线头带辉光和光晕。透视相机视场角 18°，6.3s 之前固定。
实体在 3.3–4.8s 于轮廓内部淡入，与轮廓绘制的最后 0.7s 重叠。最宽的高光是单独一层光，在实体之后的 3.8–5.3s 出现。轮廓在 4.6–5.7s 降到 14%，6.3–8.2s 慢推 5%。另有 2.8s 的 logo 版本，线框 0.4s，填充擦除 0.6s。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会把轮廓、实体和高光分成三层来做。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 什么是描边到实体的显形？
形状先以线稿出现，比如线框或光线画出的路径，再填成实心或材质。观众先记住轮廓，再看到材质。
填充之后轮廓还要保留吗？
这支片子里轮廓在 4.6–5.7s 降到 14%，此时实体已经进入。保留的淡线起到轮廓提示作用，主体交给实体。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
